parts.text: A student performs an experiment on the cooling of water contained in a beaker. He investigates the effect of the colour of the outside surface of the beaker on the rate of cooling. He uses the apparatus shown in Fig. 2.1. Beaker A is covered with black card. Beaker B is covered with shiny metal foil. Fig. 2.1

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) Record room temperature θ R shown on the thermometer in Fig. 2.1. θ R = ......................................................... [1]

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) The student pours a volume of 150 cm 3 of hot water into beaker A and records the temperature θ at time t = 0.

ms.label: 2(b)(i)
ms.text:
suitable precaution e.g.:
view scale reading perpendicularly
wait until reading stops rising
avoid thermometer touching beaker

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Add units to the column headings in Table 2.1. [1] Table 2.1 beaker A with black card beaker B with shiny metal foil t / θ / θ / 0 86.0 85.5 30 80.5 83.5 60 76.0 82.0 90 73.0 80.5 120 71.0 79.5 150 69.5 79.0 180 68.5 78.5

ms.label: 2(c)
ms.text:
statement matching readings in table – ‘beaker Bcools more slowly’ / owtte
comparison of temperature changes over 180 s, matching statement (need to see values used in justification)

parts.label: i
parts.text: (d) (i) Calculate the average cooling rate x A for the water in beaker A during the experiment. Use the readings for beaker A from Table 2.1 and the equation x A = θ 0 – θ 180 T where T = 180 s and θ 0 and θ 180 are the temperatures of the water in beaker A at times t = 0 and t = 180 s. Include the unit for the cooling rate. x A = ......................................................... [1]

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Calculate the average cooling rate x B for the water in beaker B during the experiment. Use the readings for beaker B from Table 2.1 and the equation x B = θ 0 – θ 180 T where T = 180 s and θ 0 and θ 180 are the temperatures of the water in beaker B at times t = 0 and t = 180 s. Include the unit. x B = ......................................................... [1]

ms.label: 2(e)(i)
ms.text: paint surfaces black OR other appropriate suggestion

ms.label: 2(e)(ii)
ms.text:
any two suitable control variables e.g.:
starting / initial temperature
same volume of water
same room temperature

ms.label: 2(e)(iii)
ms.text:
beaker A cooling rate > xA and suitable explanation
cooling rate of A greater than xA
